1	/-

     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChange
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The finite-stage Picard gluing diagram after base change
    10	
    11	The chart and overlap comparisons identify the multispan diagram obtained by
    12	base-changing the finite-stage gluing with the canonical diagram of the exact
    13	separably closed atlas.
    14	-/
    15	
    16	set_option autoImplicit false
    17	
    18	universe u
    19	
    20	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    21	open scoped TensorProduct
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	noncomputable section
    26	
    27	/-- The spectrum of an algebra homomorphism lies over the base spectrum. -/
    28	theorem specMap_algHom_comp_algebraMap
    29	    {R A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    30	    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (r : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    31	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom r.toRingHom) ≫
    32	        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) =
    33	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)) := by
    34	  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
    35	  rw [← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    36	  congr 1
    37	  ext x
    38	  exact r.commutes x
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    41	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    42	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    43	
    44	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    45	
    46	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    47	-- Raw tensor carriers keep the dependent finite-subextension instances visible.
    48	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    49	/-- An overlap in the base-changed finite-stage gluing is the corresponding
    50	overlap in the canonical gluing diagram of the exact Picard atlas. -/
    51	noncomputable def gluingOverlapIso
    52	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    53	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    54	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    55	    (Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
    56	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).V (U, V) ≅
    57	      (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).V (U, V) := by
    58	  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic P.L.1 k := by infer_instance
    59	  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic P.M.1 k := by infer_instance
    60	  let r :=
    61	    AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    62	      (R := P.M.1) (K := P.N.1)
    63	        (P.mapM (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (U, V))))
    64	  have hStructure :=
    65	    calc
    66	      P.glueData.f U V ≫ P.glueData.ι U ≫ P.gluedMap =
    67	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom r.toRingHom) ≫
    68	            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 _)) := by
    69	        rw [glueData_f C P U V, glueData_ι_gluedMap C P U]
    70	        rfl
    71	      _ = _ := specMap_algHom_comp_algebraMap r
    72	  exact
    73	    gluingOverlapFlatteningIso C P U V ≪≫
    74	      pullback.congrHom hStructure rfl ≪≫
    75	      overlapBaseChangeIso C P U V ≪≫
    76	      (isPullback_opens_inf U.1.1 V.1.1).isoPullback
    77	
    78	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    79	
    80	end
    81	
    82	end AlgebraicGeometry

events.text: The independent post-base-change audit confirms an important roadmap correction: the current filtered-colimit theorem is circular because it assumes the arbitrary-field representer. Even after the global object isomorphism, the real remaining gates are universal-equivalence descent, finite-Galois refinement, orbit-in-affine, and quotient geometry; I’ll record that after this unit is rooted.

The reviewed file is scoped correctly and clean. I’m making one existing-file edit now: import the new module in `Pic0CriticalPath` and add explicit `#check`/`#print axioms` roots for both the algebra-map helper and `gluingOverlapIso`.
The root’s only diagnostic is the expected “imports out of date” condition. I’m releasing the completed LSP workers, checking the shared build lane, then compiling the new module and root serially.

+/-

+Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
+Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
+-/
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChange
+
+/-!
+# The finite-stage Picard gluing diagram after base change
+
+The chart and overlap comparisons identify the multispan diagram obtained by
+base-changing the finite-stage gluing with the canonical diagram of the exact
+separably closed atlas.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
+open scoped TensorProduct
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry
+
+noncomputable section
+
+/-- The spectrum of an algebra homomorphism lies over the base spectrum. -/
+theorem specMap_algHom_comp_algebraMap
+    {R A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
+    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (r : A →ₐ[R] B) :
+    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom r.toRingHom) ≫
+        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) =
+      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)) := by
+  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
+  rw [← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
+  congr 1
+  ext x
+  exact r.commutes x
+
+variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
+variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
+  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
+
+namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
+
+set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
+-- Raw tensor carriers keep the dependent finite-subextension instances visible.
+set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
+/-- An overlap in the base-changed finite-stage gluing is the corresponding
+overlap in the canonical gluing diagram of the exact Picard atlas. -/
+noncomputable def gluingOverlapIso
+    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
+    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
+    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
+    (Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
+        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).V (U, V) ≅
+      (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).V (U, V) := by
+  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic P.L.1 k := by infer_instance
+  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic P.M.1 k := by infer_instance
+  let r :=
+    AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
+      (R := P.M.1) (K := P.N.1)
+        (P.mapM (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (U, V))))
+  have hStructure :=
+    calc
+      P.glueData.f U V ≫ P.glueData.ι U ≫ P.gluedMap =
+          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom r.toRingHom) ≫
+            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 _)) := by
+        rw [glueData_f C P U V, glueData_ι_gluedMap C P U]
+        rfl
+      _ = _ := specMap_algHom_comp_algebraMap r
+  exact
+    gluingOverlapFlatteningIso C P U V ≪≫
+      pullback.congrHom hStructure rfl ≪≫
+      overlapBaseChangeIso C P U V ≪≫
+      (isPullback_opens_inf U.1.1 V.1.1).isoPullback
+
+end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
+
+end
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry
